reviewed_by: Claude Code, building the operator-approved Butler goal board mockup (Figma tVEa0PXZaa7H4ZLflwgcb7, node 208:3)
reason: The Butler mode status board now lists goal chats only, in Active, Idle and Completed sections per project. GET /butler/board selects chat_goals rows by kind and project, joins their chats by ID, returns exact section counts in total and per project, pages within a section (section=, project_id=; state=idle still pages Idle), reads pending turns from the status index and each Active chat's newest turn with one backward index step, and encodes its body once for the ETag and response. Selected: the board's real-Core API suites (test_runtime_global_project_reads.py, test_butler_goal_chat_proposals.py), the brief, file-attribution and polling-cost suites that share butler_board helpers, chat_turn_headers and conditional_reads, the Butler mode product-help tests by node ID including the new goal-sections check, the board's unit and component tests, and the butler-mode real-Core LAN journey in desktop, compact, Chromium 390 and WebKit 390.
exclusions: tests/v3/test_product_knowledge.py is selected by node ID: test_product_search_finds_headless_core_and_paired_butler_cli already fails on pristine origin/main. No other surface reads /butler/board (git grep across ui/ and src/). The Butler workflow registry is unchanged: no UI API call signature changed (the check still reports the same 2 unreviewed signatures as main). Other butler-mode viewports (320, 430) and unrelated Playwright areas are not selected.
